# Portrait fixture

`fictional-presenter.png` was made for the MuseTalk acceptance test with the built-in imagegen tool. It depicts a fictional adult.

Prompt:

> Use case: photorealistic-natural. Single square test fixture for a local audio-driven portrait animator. Create a realistic straight-on studio head-and-shoulders photograph of one fictional adult presenter, dark brown eyes, short wavy dark hair, softly lit skin, navy shirt, solid muted teal background. Neutral closed lips, head upright, eyes looking into the camera. Entire face and crown clearly visible, symmetrical and centered, chin near the lower third. Even soft light, neutral color, plain background. No facial occlusions, hands, accessories, text, branding, or watermark.
